_comment: Z-Image Turbo 6B (Q4_K_M GGUF), text-to-image, ComfyUI API format.
This makes the master frame — the still every beat frame is later edited
from, and therefore the thing that decides whether the actor stays the same
person across the cut. It is the one image in the pipeline worth caring about
at draft stage, which is why it gets a real model rather than a placeholder.
Turbo is distilled: 8 steps at cfg 1.0. Distilled weights carry the guidance
internally, so a base model's cfg 7-8 produces burnt, oversaturated frames.
The text encoder type below is deliberately not 'z_image' — there is no such
CLIPType. ComfyUI routes Qwen3-4B to the Z-Image encoder from the state dict
itself (comfy/sd.py, TEModel.QWEN3_4B), and the `type` field only matters for
steering it towards Flux instead. 'lumina2' is the closest honest label, since
Generated at the draft video size so LTX consumes it without resampling.
